children.text: Greeting & Opinion on the Most Important Invention
children.cn: 问候与点明最重要发明

children.text: Hello, everyone. I am Li Hui.
children.cn: 大家好。我是李辉。
children.notes: 题目给定的开头第一句，不计入词数
children.statement: “Hello, everyone.” 是英语演讲中常用的礼貌问候语。
children.explanation: 演讲开头使用 Hello, everyone 进行问候十分亲切自然。

children.text: Today I am honored to talk about China's new four great inventions.
children.cn: 今天我很荣幸能谈论中国的新四大发明。
children.notes: be honored to do sth.: 感到很荣幸做某事; invention: 发明（名词）
children.statement: “be honored to do sth.” 表示“做某事感到十分荣幸”。
children.explanation: honored 为形容词，意为“感到荣幸的”。
children.keywords: honored, talk about, new four great inventions

children.text: Among all of them, I think the high-speed train is the most important one.
children.cn: 在所有这些发明中，我认为高铁是最重要的一个。
children.notes: among all of them: 在所有它们之中; high-speed train: 高铁; the most important: 最重要的
children.statement: “the most important” 是形容词 important 的最高级形式。
children.explanation: 多音节形容词的最高级前面加 the most。
children.keywords: Among all of them, high-speed train, most important

children.text: How It Changes People's Lifestyles
children.cn: 高铁如何改变人们的生活方式

children.text: It has changed our lifestyle in many helpful ways.
children.cn: 它在许多有益的方面改变了我们的生活方式。
children.notes: change our lifestyle: 改变我们的生活方式; helpful ways: 有益的方式
children.statement: “has changed” 是现在完成时，表示过去发生对现在产生影响。
children.explanation: 现在完成时结构为 have/has + 过去分词。

children.text: First, high-speed trains travel very fast, so they make long-distance travel much easier and save people a lot of time.
children.cn: 首先，高铁行驶速度非常快，因此它们让长途旅行变得更加轻松，并为人们节省了大量时间。
children.notes: travel fast: 行驶迅速; make... easier: 使……更轻松; save time: 节省时间
children.statement: “so” 在句中作连词，引导结果状语从句。
children.explanation: so 表示因果关系中的“因此，所以”。
children.keywords: First, travel fast, long-distance travel, save time

children.text: Second, the train carriages are quiet and comfortable, which makes every trip safe and pleasant.
children.cn: 其次，火车车厢安静舒适，这使得每次旅程都既安全又令人愉快。
children.notes: train carriage: 火车车厢; comfortable: 舒适的; pleasant: 令人愉快的
children.statement: “pleasant” 是形容词，意为“令人愉快的”。
children.explanation: pleasant 常用来修饰事物，表示“令人舒适愉悦的”。
children.keywords: Second, quiet and comfortable, safe and pleasant

children.text: Call to Action & Closing
children.cn: 发出倡议与致谢结语

children.text: As Chinese students, we should be proud of our great country and modern technology.
children.cn: 作为中国学生，我们应该为我们伟大的国家和现代科技感到自豪。
children.notes: as: 作为（介词）; be proud of: 为……感到骄傲自豪; modern technology: 现代科技
children.statement: “be proud of” 是表示“为……自豪”的经典固定搭配。
children.explanation: be proud of 后面接名词或代词作宾语。
children.keywords: Chinese students, proud of, great country, modern technology

children.text: Let us study hard and use our knowledge to build an even brighter future!
children.cn: 让我们努力学习，用我们的知识去创造更加光明的未来吧！
children.notes: study hard: 努力学习; use knowledge: 使用知识; brighter future: 更光明的未来
children.statement: “Let us do sth.” 用于发出倡议和号召。
children.explanation: Let sb. do sth. 祈使句结构，后接动词原形。
children.keywords: Let us, study hard, use knowledge, brighter future

children.text: Thank you for your listening!
children.cn: 感谢大家的聆听！
children.notes: 题目给定的结尾句，不计入词数
children.statement: 题目给定的演讲结束语，不计入字数。
children.explanation: 根据题目要求，已给出的结尾内容不计入总词数。

tree.cn: 中国的新四大发明（进阶范文）

children.text: Greeting & Visionary Selection of Key Invention
children.cn: 问候与点题：高度评价高铁核心地位

children.text: Hello, everyone. I am Li Hui.
children.cn: 大家好。我是李辉。
children.notes: 题目给定的开头第一句，严格保留原样且不计入词数
children.statement: 给定句首句与基础版保持完全一致。
children.explanation: 题目给定句在两篇范文中均一字不改保留。

children.text: It is my great honor to deliver a speech on China's new four great inventions today.
children.cn: 今天非常荣幸能就中国的新四大发明发表演讲。
children.notes: It is one's great honor to do sth.: 做某事是某人的莫大荣幸; deliver a speech: 发表演讲
children.statement: “deliver a speech” 是“发表演讲”的高级地道搭配。
children.explanation: deliver 可以表示正式发表（演说、讲话）。
children.keywords: great honor, deliver speech, new four great inventions

children.text: Among these four technological marvels, I firmly believe that the high-speed train plays the most significant role in our national development.
children.cn: 在这四项科技奇迹中，我坚信高铁在国家发展中发挥着最为重大的作用。
children.notes: technological marvels: 科技奇迹; firmly believe: 坚信; play a significant role: 发挥重要作用
children.statement: “play a significant role in” 意为“在……中起着重要作用”。
children.explanation: significant 是 important 的高级同义词。
children.keywords: Among marvels, firmly believe, high-speed train, significant role

children.text: Profound Transformations in Lifestyles
children.cn: 全方位深刻重塑人们的生活与连接

children.text: This advanced transportation network has profoundly reshaped our daily life.
children.cn: 这一先进的交通网络深刻地重塑了我们的日常生活。
children.notes: transportation network: 交通运输网络; profoundly: 深刻地（副词）; reshape: 重塑（动词）
children.statement: “profoundly” 在此修饰动词 reshaped，表示影响的深度与广度。
children.explanation: profoundly 意为“深刻地，极其地”。
children.keywords: advanced transportation network, profoundly reshaped, daily life

children.text: On the one hand, its remarkable speed significantly narrows the distance between distant cities, enabling people to travel hundreds of kilometers within hours.
children.cn: 一方面，其惊人的速度显著缩短了遥远城市之间的距离，使人们能够在数小时内跨越数百公里。
children.notes: remarkable speed: 惊人的速度; narrow the distance: 缩短距离; enable sb. to do sth.: 使某人能够做某事
children.statement: “enabling ...” 是现在分词短语作伴随状语或结果状语。
children.explanation: 现在分词短语在句尾常作结果状语，表示自然而然带来的结果。
children.keywords: On the one hand, remarkable speed, narrows distance, enabling travel

children.text: On the other hand, the clean, punctual, and smooth carriages provide passengers with a pleasant working and resting environment.
children.cn: 另一方面，整洁、准点且平稳的车厢为乘客提供了宜人的工作与休息环境。
children.notes: punctual: 准时的，准点的; smooth: 平稳的; provide sb. with sth.: 为某人提供某物
children.statement: “provide sb. with sth.” 是常见的双宾语替换结构，意为“给某人提供某物”。
children.explanation: provide 搭配 with 表示给某人提供某种物品或条件。
children.keywords: On the other hand, punctual and smooth, provide with, pleasant environment

children.text: Inspiring Call to Action & Concluding Gratitude
children.cn: 鼓舞人心的倡议号召与致谢

children.text: Therefore, we should not only take pride in these great technological milestones but also cherish them.
children.cn: 因此，我们不仅应该为这些伟大的科技里程碑感到自豪，更应该倍加珍惜它们。
children.notes: take pride in: 为……自豪; milestones: 里程碑; cherish: 珍惜，珍爱
children.statement: “not only ... but also ...” 引导并列结构，意为“不仅……而且……”。
children.explanation: not only... but also... 能够有效增强句式的论辩力度。
children.keywords: Therefore, take pride in, technological milestones, cherish

children.text: Let us study enthusiastically and equip ourselves with science to contribute to our motherland in the future!
children.cn: 让我们充满热情地学习，用科学武装自己，在未来为我们的祖国贡献力量！
children.notes: enthusiastically: 热情地; equip oneself with: 用……装备自己; contribute to: 为……做出贡献
children.statement: “contribute to” 中的 “to” 是介词，表示“为……做贡献”。
children.explanation: contribute to sth. 意为对某事业作出贡献。
children.keywords: Let us, study enthusiastically, equip with science, contribute to motherland

children.text: Thank you for your listening!
children.cn: 感谢大家的聆听！
children.notes: 题目给定的结尾句，严格保留原样且不计入词数
children.statement: 题目给定结尾句在进阶版中完全保持原样，不计入字数。
children.explanation: 两篇范文均严格遵循题目给定的结尾要求。
